questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The Prime Minister was ______ with a ceremonial welcome.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is Option 2.**

The sentence 'The Prime Minister was **extended **with a ceremonial welcome' means he was **bestowed long and warmly with honour at the time of 'welcome'. **

All other options are irrelevant as they mean :

 
• **Invite:** To make a polite request to welcome. 
 
• **Initiated:** To begin, to start.
 
• **Expected: **regarded as likely; anticipated.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Scientists all over the world are engaged in ______ how to find a vaccine for COVID-19.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'investigating'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the **meanings **of the given words-

 
 
• **Scrutinizing**- to examine something very carefully (किसी चीज की बहुत सावधानी से जांच करना)
 
• **Investigating**- to try to discover the facts about something. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में सभी तथ्यों को खोजने की कोशिश करना) 
 
• **Researching**- detailed study of a subject in order to discover new information. (नई जानकारी की खोज के लिए किसी विषय का विस्तृत अध्ययन)
 
• **Inspecting**- to officially visit a building or organization, in order to check that everything is correct and legal. (आधिकारिक तौर पर किसी भवन या संगठन का दौरा करने के लिए, यह जांचने के लिए कि सब कुछ सही और कानूनी है)
 
 
 
• Here, the word **investigating** is more applicable as the sentence implies that scientists are closely searching for facts related to the vaccine.
 
• Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• You may be confused between researching and investigating but it is an official question of **SSC CHSL 12 Aug 2021 Shift 3.**
 
• **Thus, no changes can be made.**

questions.question:
**Fill in the blank with the most suitable word.**

Remember that, little sister: wait for a man to ______ your honour, and you’ll wait forever.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is:** Avenge.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given context, the phrase** "wait for a man to avenge your honour" **means waiting for a man to take action and seek revenge on behalf of the person's honor.
 
• It implies that relying on someone else to protect or restore honor may result in waiting indefinitely.
 
• The word **"avenge"** means to take revenge or seek retribution for a wrongdoing or harm that has been done, typically to protect one's honor, rights, or the rights of others. (प्रतिशोध करना) 
 
 
• **Example: **After years of planning and gathering evidence, the detective finally had the opportunity to **avenge **his partner's murder by capturing the elusive criminal responsible for the heinous act.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

**Correct Sentence__:* ****Remember that, little sister: wait for a man to __**avenge**__ your honour, and you’ll wait forever.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's analyze the other options:
 
 
• **comfort:** This word refers to providing emotional support or consolation. However, it does not fit the context of seeking justice or taking revenge for one's honor. (सान्त्वना देना, दिलासा देना)
 
• **cheer: **This word means to express happiness or support. It does not fit the context of seeking justice or taking revenge. (प्रोत्साहन देना)
 
• **repeal: **This word means to revoke or annul a law or regulation. It does not convey the meaning of seeking revenge for honor. (खण्डन करना,निष्प्रभाव करना)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4) avenge,** as it accurately reflects the idea of taking action to seek revenge for one's honor.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate word.

I am sorry to ______ on you at this late hour.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, someone is sorry because the one goes into a place where the one is not expected to be.
 
• **Intrude **on/into (verb) means "to go into a place or situation in which the person is not expected to be".
 
• **Intrude **means intervene or invade.

So base on the above points, the appropriate word is **"Intrude".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Interrupt means "to stop something from happening for a short period".
 
 
• For example, You are really impatient and always interrupt my speech.
 
 
 
• Instruct means "to tell someone to do something formally".
 
 
• For example, Students were instructed to stay in a queue.
 
 
 
• Interfere means "to involve yourself in a situation when your involvement is not helpful".
 
 
• He should never interfere between a husband and wife.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Point__**

 
• In the given options, Intrude is the only word that makes the sentence meaningful and follows the preposition "On".

Hence, the correct sentence is "*I am sorry to **intrude** on you at this late hour"*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Schools will restart physical classes partially and states have ______ their own conditions and procedures to ensure the safety of students.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'devised.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about the preparations made by the schools and states to ensure the safety of students.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'devised'.
 
• The word 'devised' means to plan or invent (a complex procedure, system, or mechanism) by careful thought. 
 
 
• Example:* A workout program was devised to help overweight men and women drop several pounds quickly*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete Sentence: *Schools will restart physical classes partially and states have devised their own conditions and procedures to ensure the safety of students*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Insisted' means **t****o **say firmly that something is true. (किसी बात पर अड़ जाना, अडिग रहना)
 
• 'Accepted' means **t****o **say yes to something or to agree to something. (सहमत होना, ‘हाँ’ करना; स्‍वीकार करना)
 
• 'Adopted' means **t****o **take and use something. (किसी विधि को अपनाना)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य छात्रों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए स्कूलों और राज्यों द्वारा की गई तैयारियों के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'devised' है।
 
• 'Devised' शब्द का अर्थ है कुछ करने का नया तरीक़ा निकालना।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *A workout program was devised to help overweight men and women drop several pounds quickly*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *Schools will restart physical classes partially and states have devised their own conditions and procedures to ensure the safety of students*.
